name: manual_ffa9dd
claim: Bind approvals to the exact head that will merge, test-only commits included, and treat any push as voiding earlier reviews; post a freeze notice on every branch; review the diff of any head you did not write before stacking on it; retarget a stacked PR's base to the default branch before merging it because the lower branch may survive its merge; merge with merge commits pinned to the approved head so approved SHAs stay reachable; never cite an agent message as operator authorization.

decisions.notes: M1 generation 2: a later test-only commit landed on the consumer branch after the harness was built and a design reviewer required a rebase and rebind; an unannounced push weakened a check; the stacked PR's base branch was not deleted after the lower PR merged. Derived from the M1 generation-2 pin promotion of 2026-10-18 and the graph-optimization gating in orama-system doc 57 section 14, the R4 plan task T8c and the operator remaining-implementation notes. Convention: .agent/references/graduation-ceremony-mutation-approvals.md.
